case_title: Narayan Malhari Thorat v. Vinayak Deora Bhagat and Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, a teacher, was alleged to have repeatedly called the wife of the victim, another teacher, on her mobile phone and harassed her. Despite the victim's attempts to stop the calls, the accused continued to call her. Three to four days before the victim's suicide, an altercation occurred between the victim and the accused. The victim left a suicide note accusing the accused of causing his death. The FIR was filed against the accused, but the High Court quashed the FIR, stating there was no prima facie evidence of the accused's intention to aid or instigate the suicide. The investigation was stalled due to the High Court's order.
